data.one_liner: Cross‑platform replacement for dart:html with DOM parsing, XML support, and EventSource.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API for manipulating HTML and XML documents on browsers, mobile, desktop, server, and Node.js. It also offers a WindowController for HTTP requests and an EventSource implementation that works outside browsers.
use_when: Need to parse or manipulate HTML/XML in a non‑browser Dart environment
Building a web scraper or crawler that runs on server or desktop
Using EventSource streams in Flutter or server apps
avoid_when: Building a full Flutter UI that relies on real browser widgets
Performance‑critical DOM manipulation where native dart:html is required
strengths: Cross‑platform API, no need to switch imports
Built‑in EventSource support with customizable headers
Comprehensive DOM query and manipulation methods
weaknesses: No Flutter widgets, only core DOM helpers
Not a UI framework, so not useful for building UIs
Requires manual handling of HTTP client for some features

alternatives.name: xml
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure XML parsing without DOM features
